findings.evidence: Added guard before service call: if (from != null && to != null && from.isAfter(to)) return ResponseEntity.badRequest().<Map<String, Object>>build();
Date predicates changed to null-safe form: (:from IS NULL OR (c.startDate IS NOT NULL AND c.startDate >= :from)) in both value and countQuery.

Service escapes % and _ before wrapping: search.replace("%", "\\%").replace("_", "\\_").toLowerCase(). JPQL LIKE clauses updated to include ESCAPE '\\'. Test getAllConferences_shouldEscapeWildcardsInSearchTerm added and GREEN.
status.trim() applied before passing to repository: String statusParam = (status != null) ? status.trim() : null. Test getAllConferences_shouldTrimStatusWhitespace added and GREEN.

Added filterVersion and lastFetchedFilterVersion refs. Fetch effect guards with: if (page !== 0 && filterVersion.current !== lastFetchedFilterVersion.current) return. Prevents fetching with stale page when filter changes while page > 0.
AbortController created in fetch effect; signal passed to getConferences (api.js updated with optional signal param); cleanup returns controller.abort(); AbortError suppressed in catch.
rawSearch state holds live input; 300 ms debounce useEffect propagates to search state. Fetch effect depends on search (debounced), not rawSearch.
handleFromDateChange and handleToDateChange set dateRangeError when fromDate > toDate; error rendered inline in red. Fetch effect skips request (setLoading(false); return) while range is invalid.
